title: Feat: Profile condense override with model-aware token caps
author: Neonsy
red_findings: Semantic divergence: global-percent uses raw context window, profile-percent uses effective budget as base
Test regression: 463 lines of existing ContextManagementSettings tests deleted, only partial replacement coverage
yellow_findings: Triple definition of ProfileCondenseOverride type across three files
Token input accepts out-of-range values before normalization clamp
22 non-English locales have English-only strings for 10 new keys
Legacy profileThresholds retained as read fallback but UI write path removed with no migration
lessons: AI-authored PRs need extra scrutiny for test deletions that discard unrelated coverage
Percentage thresholds need documented base when two controls use different denominators
Legacy setting supersession needs migration path or UI visibility notice
